crops.reading: 159 cab car (DMCL): identical to the 158 diagram pixel for pixel (doors 146-225/1501-1580, windows, cab window, roof boxes); navy cab end to a diagonal at 9.6-11.4 m, white beyond, navy band below 1.27 m, yellow line at the bottom; first door white, second navy with light blue edges.
Middle car (MSL): a small window at both ends, a two-leaf door at both ends (navy, light blue edges), nine saloon windows; white with the navy lower band; 'SWR' logos.

crops.feature: middle car front end: small window, door
crops.reading: Middle car front end: small window 0.98-1.35 m, door 1.68-2.75 m, as the 158's next car.

crops.feature: navy cab end, diagonal to white, first door
crops.reading: Navy cab end (steel blue in the low sun) meeting white at a straight diagonal leaning back; first door white; navy band continues low under the white.
crops.reading2: navy section with cab window, door leaves and three saloon windows; meets off-white at a diagonal from top centre down and to the left; door with light blue trim at the right; orange line along the top.

crops.feature: cab corner and first door, three-quarter
crops.reading: Corner: yellow face wraps a few cm, navy side, cab window, white two-leaf door.
crops.reading2: cab-side window two panes with angled lower pane, then part of a pair of doors; left pod lit round lamp outer, right pod LED cluster centre, round lamp outer.

crops.reading: 159002: yellow round the screens down to below the lamp boxes; navy lower face, black skirt (in shade); headlamps outboard.
crops.reading2: yellow upper face, dark navy/black lower front and valance; black gangway surround round a yellow door with a dark bottom; plain round lamps outer, LED clusters centre.

crops.feature: middle car front, navy lower band
crops.reading: Middle car: white with navy lower band, navy two-leaf doors with light blue at the top, orange cantrail line.
crops.reading2: mostly cream bodyside with a navy band along the bottom and an orange line under the roof; two pairs of door leaves with navy trim and light blue at their tops.

crops.reading: As 158 f-face-hd: yellow above, navy below a straight line under the lamp boxes; no gangway door window.
crops.reading2: yellow upper face and dark navy lower half; lamp pods: plain round lamp outer, red LED centre on both sides.

crops.reading: Headlamp outboard, red LED tail inboard.
crops.reading2: clear round lamp outer, red LED cluster centre.
red LED centre side, clear round lamp outer.

crops.reading: Destination, glass, number panel, lamp box in one black recess.
crops.reading2: orange display at the top, windscreen with wiper, black band with '159 012', yellow surround.

crops.feature: lower face: navy band, slot, skirt
crops.reading: Navy lower face with black slots; navy skirt; coupler pocket.
crops.reading2: lower front dark navy with valance and separate lower skirt; yellow meets navy at a straight horizontal line.
